title: spiraea media subsp. sericea
intro: Spiraea media subsp. sericea, commonly known as Snow Rose or Hardhack, is a flowering plant species in the rose family that is native to North America. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Spiraea media subsp. sericea include wound healing, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
